name: Menhera Slave
source:
The main character, Yoshitaka Hachiya, helps a classmate who suffers from a panic disorder called Takatori Koyoi. It was Yoshitaka who became friends with Takanori Koyoi, but Koyoi gradually began to show an unusual attachment to Yoshitaka.

And one day, Yoshitaka is finally raped tonight ...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ288934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公蜂屋义高帮助了饱受惊恐障碍困扰的同班同学高取今宵。两人因此成为朋友，但今宵渐渐对义高表现出了异乎寻常的执着。

直到某一天，义高终于遭到了今宵的强暴……
